BEAUTY QUEENS RALLY AGAINST CORRUPTION

Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray and Miss Philippines Earth 2025 Joy Barcoma used their voices to protest corruption amid the flood control scandal during the second Trillion Peso March at the People Power Monument in Quezon City on Sunday, Nov. 30.

Reports indicate that the  29-year-old OFW, who arrived in Hong Kong on November 25, refused to leave the three-month-old baby in her care, staying with the infant until they were rescued along with the child’s mother.

Kabilang si Catriona Gray sa celebrities na dumalo sa anti-corruption protest sa People Power Monument sa EDSA nitong Linggo, at hinimok niya ang mga Pinoy na ‘walang magmo-move on hangga't walang nananagot,” kaugnay ng kontrobersiya sa umano’y maanomalyang flood control projects.

"And to those who think the Filipino spirit is weak, nagkakamali kayo. Sinasabi nila na Filipinos have a short memory, it's easy for us to forget and forgive," ayon kay Catriona nang magbigay ng talumpati sa stage.
